messages:
Daniel H: FYI: noticed a small but persistent skew where tokens emitted near the hourly boundary are landing in the *prior* invoice period after consumer rebalances. affects a handful of tenants with bursty traffic.
Priya S: example? any logs/offsets to look at?
Daniel H: here's a reconciler output for tenant t-eagle:
```
WARN reconciler tenant=t-eagle window_end=2026-03-21T09:00:00Z event_ts=2026-03-21T08:59:59.875 partition=12 offset=345678 applied_to_invoice=2026-03-21T08:00:00Z
INFO ingest consumer_rebalance partition=12 old_owner=aggregator-3 new_owner=aggregator-7 last_committed_offset=345670
```
Daniel H: so event timestamp is before the boundary but partition commit lag causes final attribution to previous aggregate. net effect: about ~0.2% of tokens get credited to previous hour and sometimes cause small negative adjustments when next hour finalizer runs.
Lucas M: sounds like we need a consistent window anchoring strategy: use watermarking + commit-on-watermark instead of commit-on-offset?
Erin C: +1 watermarking. but we must be careful: we can't delay commits too long for latency-sensitive tenants. maybe make window_anchor configurable per-tenant (0ms, 250ms, 2s).
Priya S: quick mitigation: make rollup finalizer use event_time-based assignment (round-down to hour) based on `producer_ts` embedded in event rather than relying on commit offset. that decouples consumer rebalance from invoice assignment. downside: must trust producer clocks.
Daniel H: we already have producer_ts but it's not surfaced to finalizer right now. producer clock skew exists but <500ms usually. for late/jittery clients it's worse.
Lucas M: propose hybrid: prefer event_time with a safety_delta = max(500ms, tenant_skew_lt95). if event_ts within safety_delta of boundary, route to provisional bucket and finalize in next cycle after cross-check.
Erin C: console UX: mark provisional tokens with an "hour-rollover" badge and a popover "This usage is provisional — final assignment may change within 1 hour". include link to adjustment history.
Priya S: spec for adjustment event we need in ledger: { type: "usage.adjustment", tenant, original_invoice, corrected_invoice, delta_tokens, reason, origin: "rebalance-late-join" } - prefer JSON in Kafka so billing system can auto-apply.
Daniel H: agree. also recommend we emit a `billing.audit.trace_id` so ops+customers can follow chain from ingest -> aggregator -> finalizer -> invoice.
infra-bot: note: creating kafka topic `billing.adjustments` (retention 30d) as requested by @Priya S.
Lucas M: infra note: we should avoid retroactively altering finalized invoices unless delta > threshold. suggest auto-apply below $0.50 or 0.5% of invoice, otherwise create a pending adjustment and surface in console for manual accept.
Priya S: billing policy debate: auto-apply small corrections improves UX but could mask recurring bugs. propose telemetry to track repeat offenders and auto-exempt tenants flagged as high-noise.
Erin C: telemetry items: `invoice.adjustments.count`, `invoice.adjustments.sum_usd`, `usage.provisional.percent`, `rebalance.late_join.count` — all with tenant and region tags. add dashboard showing top tenants by adjustments.
Daniel H: rollout plan: 1) add safety_delta logic to finalizer in shadow mode, 2) emit `billing.adjustment` events when shadow != live, 3) run comparison job for 48h, 4) flip on tenanted rollout with opt-out flag.
Priya S: I'll draft the PR for finalizer shadow mode + adjustment event schema. Lucas, can you draft the billing policy for auto-apply thresholds?
Lucas M: will do, target doc by EOD.
Erin C: I'll wire up console change: provisional badge + adjustment history panel. want a tiny CTA to "view adjustment details" that links to the audit trace.
billing-bot: reminder: Finance approval required for automated invoice mutations above $1.00 USD. please escalate if policy needs update.
Priya S: noted. we'll keep auto-apply conservative (<$0.50) until finance signs off.
Daniel H: I'll add a runbook entry for customer support: when tenant reports unexpected invoice delta, check `rebalance.late_join.count` and `billing.adjustment` events before opening a billing ticket.
infra-bot: canary deploy scheduled for finalizer v2.0-shadow for 10 tenants in us-west. start time 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z.
Daniel H: thanks all. keeping this thread for rollout notes and any strange telemetry spikes. feel free to ping me if you want sample queries for affected tenants.
